entries.gap: Loc now preserves Binary/Random/Sequential mode units, Reset closes all channels, Write # covers multi-value scalar formatting, Print # accepts an empty output list, Lock/Unlock maps Binary/Random ranges plus Sequential whole-file locks, and Open Access/sharing clauses map to explicit FileAccess/FileShare policies; omitted For defaults to Random with length 128. Sequential Print #, Write #, Input # and Line Input # now use stable UTF-8 for Deterministic and the active Windows ANSI code page for VB6Sp6. Input # restores scalar Variant state markers and binary Get/Put supports scalar Variant type tags; Variant arrays, object values and incoming SAFEARRAY tags currently fail explicitly with a type mismatch, while their complete layouts, richer UDT layouts and remaining file modes remain open.
